permitted_testing_scope: Single-tenant local workstation testing, hackathon evaluation, controlled firmware fixture repair, and internal demonstration. Not permitted for open multi-tenant public deployment without authentication proxy.

findings.title: Absence of Authentication & Authorization Gateway
findings.remediation: Deploy behind authenticating reverse proxy (OAuth2-Proxy / Cloudflare Access) for multi-user deployment.

findings.title: Unauthenticated AI Provider Reconfiguration Endpoint
findings.remediation: Restrict /api/v1/ai/providers/configure to localhost or authenticated administrative role.

findings.title: Startup Crash on Non-Boolean Environment DEBUG String
findings.remediation: Applied field_validator on Settings.DEBUG with regression test.

findings.title: Transitive Vulnerability in dompurify (monaco-editor)
findings.remediation: Execute npm audit fix when Monaco editor upstream releases patch.

findings.title: Native Binary Execution on Linux Hosts Without Container Sandbox
findings.remediation: Windows execution defaults to simulation; provided Dockerfile for isolated container execution on Linux.

findings.title: Secondary AI Providers (OpenAI & Ollama) Return Templated Responses
findings.remediation: Primary Google Gemini SDK is fully functional; secondary providers marked as optional prototypes.
